items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: On this was Billie Holiday... and I played bass, too. ... This was with Louis Armstrong, also Billie Holiday

ctx.x: We were talking about what happened at Billy Berg's and how Strayhorn brought us "A Train" actually before Duke ever played it. But Billy Berg's was such a fantastic place; I don't know whether we really realized it at the time. But during this period, Slim and Slam worked there, Billie Holiday, Leo Watson, Teddy Bunn and the Spirits of Rhythm, and we were working at the same time.
You mean all on the same bill.
